checks.responsive: Gallery plus all three pilots checked at measured 360, 768 and 1440 CSS px. Additional pilot checks at 390px. Final checks found no horizontal overflow.
checks.enlargement: Gallery at measured 390px with root font 32px (200%) found no horizontal overflow.
interactions: Save sample changes pressed state and feedback without altering a journey.
No-result search displays recovery; empty contribution focuses the invalid field with associated message.
A synthetic review preference/note survived reload; both were reset through UI.
Current/proposed pilot comparison switches the candidate stylesheet off/on.
checks.contrast: Normal text roles ink, sea, earth, muted and danger meet 4.5:1 on both canvas and panel. Sea action with light text meets 4.5:1. Decoration and disabled controls are not included in this claim.
checks.tablet_fix: Initial Chilika 768px viewport expanded to 1110px from an aspect-ratio/min-height interaction. Candidate adapter fixed; final client/inner/scroll widths all 768px.
checks.public_output: Compared every file against the prior release manifest; no output changed.

limitations: Implementation self-review, not an independent design or accessibility certification.
The 200% text check covers the gallery; full browser zoom, every legacy pilot text size, physical devices and assistive screen readers remain unverified.
Odia wording and typography need fluent human review. New typefaces and component details are candidates for visual approval.
Existing native PDF/A4 pagination remains unverified; no new PDF claim.
Pilot links can lead to baseline copied pages; only the three explicitly named pilots use the candidate adapter.
Review-note and photo-book download controls do not by themselves verify the downloaded browser bytes. The packaged library archive was independently inspected.
UTP public source/output and other projects were not migrated or published.
